title: Microglia Rank signaling regulates GnRH neuronal function and the hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal axis | Science
content: The hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal axis (HPG) controls pubertal development, sexual maturation, and fertility. We identified a role of hypothalamic microglia in controlling the HPG axis through receptor activator of nuclear factor κB (Rank) signaling. ...
